title: Automated AI Code Review in CI/CD
description: Deploy automated AI code review bots in GitHub Actions to detect security vulnerabilities, anti-patterns, and EF Core N+1 queries in C# pull requests.

data.text: Automating Code Quality in GitHub Pull Requests

Human code review is critical for architectural alignment and mentoring, but human reviewers frequently miss subtle concurrency deadlocks, unhandled CancellationToken propagation, or Entity Framework Core N+1 query traps. Deploying an automated AI code review bot directly in your GitHub Actions PR workflow provides instant, objective static analysis on every pull request before human engineers begin their review.
High-Value Code Smells for AI Review in .NET

rows: Blocking on Task.Result can cause thread pool exhaustion and deadlocks.
Lazy loading navigation properties inside a foreach loop
Querying related entities inside loop causes N database roundtrips. Use .Include().
Async method accepts ct but fails to pass it downstream
Downstream HTTP client or database query will not abort if client disconnects.
String interpolation in FromSqlRaw() or Dapper
Potential SQL injection vulnerability. Use parameterized arguments.
Subscribing to long-lived static events without unsubscribe
Publisher holds reference preventing garbage collection.

data.text: GitHub Actions Workflow for Automated AI Review
The GitHub Actions workflow below fetches the git diff of the PR, prompts Azure OpenAI with .NET enterprise rules, and posts constructive comments directly to the pull request.

data.title: GitHub Actions AI Code Review Workflow (YAML)
data.content: Extracts git diff and posts automated AI review feedback:
data.code:
name: AI Pull Request Reviewer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    paths:
      - '**.cs'

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Get PR Diff
      id: diff
      run: |
        git diff origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD -- '*.cs' > pr_diff.txt

    - name: Run .NET AI Code Review Bot
      env:
        AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT }}
        AZURE_OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.AZURE_OPENAI_KEY }}
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        dotnet run --project tools/AiReviewBot -- --diff pr_diff.txt --pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Automate initial PR code reviews to catch common C# bugs before human review
Train prompts to detect sync-over-async (.Result), EF Core N+1 queries, and unhandled tokens
Ensure AI review feedback is constructive, specific, and includes proposed code snippets
Require human approval for all PR merges: treat AI reviews as an automated first pass
Integrate directly with GitHub Checks API to surface inline line comments
data.takeaway: Automated AI code review acts as a continuous quality filter, catching security bugs and performance traps early while freeing senior engineers to focus on architectural design.
